reviews.text: Dr. Katie always gives the best care and advice. Her staff is very attentive as well. Would not go anywhere else for Lily's care :)

This place is an absolute joke. What kind of a place doesn’t take walk-ins for pet parents we’re having an emergency. Tell me they don’t have a availability until five when it’s absolutely empty with one person who is a receptionist sitting alone on the phone when I have an emergency on my hands, I’m supposed to wait for my dog until 10 hours and letting them suffer. Do not come here as you need an appointment so pre-plan your emergencies everybody because apparently that’s the only way it works.
I highly recommend using Desert Ridge Animal Hospital for all your pet needs. Dr. Berman and his staff delivered quality care to my dog Louie and also addressed any concerns that I might have had.

I changed vets this year primarily due to location. I am so happy I did but for a number of reasons much more important than location. The office is nice and clean. The follow up with the vets is outstanding.  They take the time to fully communicate and explain what is going on my fur baby.  Giving recommendations and being proactive in the overall health of my pet.

I've always had a welcoming and smooth experience here with my two girls (young Siamese cats) which has been so helpful as a first-time pet owner. Dr Kendra Thomas and her staff are extremely kind & caring; they are thorough in assessing the problem and will make sure you leave feeling assured and confident in your pet's health!
So gentle and caring!

Animal Hospital is the best Veterinarian hospital in the valley! I would not ever bring my little dog Marley anywhere else after being lucky enough to find Dr Thomas and the rest of the staff of course. It is a beautiful environment and when you walk through the door, you will realize you are at a five star situation & they are competitively priced! consider myself extremely fortunate to have found Animal Hospital through my neighbor..
The Staff gives above and beyond in the care of our pet. They are always courteous, helpful and respectful.

The most outstanding Veterinarian care.
I would highly recommend Dr. Kendra Thomas and her  wonderful staff. They have always been so caring, responsive, and empathetic to my beloved dog through young adulthood and beyond.
I can’t imagine going to another clinic. The amazing support they have provided to me and my pet goes beyond words.
Thank you Desert Ridge/Grayhawk
Care was great for my dog. The vet found something I had no clue he had and I am so glad I took him in. Thank you!

Dr. Kendra and the entire staff at Desert Ridge Animal Hospital are beyond amazing.

We woke up to a scare every pet owner dreads: our 17-year-old cat, Strikie, was vomiting, 105 degree fever, lethargic, and weak—not eating, not drinking, and hiding from us. He's family, and we were terrified. I called Desert Ridge immediately, and they got us in within two hours.

When we walked through the doors, the staff was already waiting for Strikie. The facility is spotless.  From that moment on, they treated him like he was their own. You can tell the entire staff are animal lovers.  He was assessed right away, and Dr. Kendra came in quickly and got to work.

What stood out most was her honesty. She was thorough and detailed in walking us through what Strikie's symptoms could mean—never sugarcoating, never overpromising. She laid out the procedures she wanted to start with and explained exactly how the results would guide the next steps, whether that meant prescribing medication or having a harder conversation about something more serious.

Strikie's test came back better than expected.  Dr. Kendra recommended to treated Strikie with nausea medication and hydrate him with an IV.  She felt it could be inflammation of the digestive system. We were sent home to monitor his fever and Dr. Kendra let us know she is available the next three days if Strikie doesn't improve.

Strikie has made almost a full recovery in 24 hours.  We believe it was an acute case of food poisoning.  Temperature is back to normal, he is eating up a storm, and acting like a healthy cat once again.

In a moment when we felt helpless and scared, Dr. Kendra and her team gave us something invaluable: trust. If you love your pet like family, this is where you want them to be if they are not feeling well.  Thank you, DR Animal Hospital.
Very caring staff that made me feel comfy that my pet would be getting the best care possible
Dr. Berman and staff are second to none in the veterinarian field. Knowledgeable, kind, caring and highly professional. You are in good hands in the beautiful facility!
Very kind and caring.
Thank you so much for taking such good care of Lily! Professional staff, great communication and high quality services.
Thank you for the 5 stars!

Safe to say the best vet I’ve ever been too. I had the pleasure of having the owner as my vet today, my dog is very nervous at the vet barks a lot, and is protective of me, they were so accommodating and sweet to her and took the time to make her feel comfortable. At the end, she loved the vet tech and was letting her give treats. They spent so much time with me answering all my questions. This location is quiet, comfortable very clean and just quite possibly the best experience I’ve ever had at a vet. You can just tell how much they actually care about the animals, and that goes such a long way.
Dr. Duffy mis-diagnosed our puppy and we almost lost him due to her negligence. Horrific experience, do not use this vet.

How this place has 4.8 stars is mind boggling. We have never in 40+ years of seeing veterinarians seen a practice so incompetent and unskilled. If you truly care about your pets, you will avoid this horror house like the plague. If you do not care what happens to your pets, then this is the place for you.
They have an ultrasound machine but nobody to use it!!??! That's helpful!!

When visiting Phoenix my dog needed to see a vet. If I lived here Desert Ridge Animal Hospital would be our new place for our dog.  Wonderful people.

The entire staff here is amazing! Everyone - from the front office, to vet techs, to veterinarians - is friendly, kind, and very helpful. We see Dr. Virdee most frequently and she is absolutely incredible! She takes a lot of time with us and answers all of our questions. We have had several pets over the years and her level of knowledge and care as a vet is unsurpassed. The office is also very clean and comfortable. We are so grateful to have found Desert Ridge Animal Hospital!

Awesome care and attention for my dog and Dr. made sure to answer all my questions.
I’ll continue to go back!!!
Staff was courteous and efficient. Very thorough assessment and helped identify potential future issues. Friendly and not pushy!
Best experience ever! The front desk is always helpful. The vet always offers a breakdown of costs and never any surprises.

We love Dr Bermen and the team at Desert Ridge Animal Hospital! Our Arthur is still training and he does well in the environment. The team is well trained and the office is calm. Arthur’s dental surgery went well with no complications. I would recommend them.
The staff, techs and doctors are true animal lovers. It’s the only place I would take my Ruby for top-notch veterinary care. A+.

Michael Berman Is the best Vet EVER! This man is knowledgeable, rational, and was not only kind to my dog but also to my husband and myself. Unfortunately we met Dr Berman at the end of my pups journey so we didn’t see him long. I wish I would have found him sooner. If we get another pup I’ll be back to this office to see Berman for sure. Thank you again for all the help and support.

Dr. Berman and the rest of the team have been kind and caring during multiple visits for our feisty (or "spicy" per the vet techs) senior cat, helping to address her health issues and offer varying treatment options. The facility is always super clean, and the wait times are nominal.
Thanks for the vote of confidence! Your feedback means a lot to us!
Staff was great, rooms were clean.
